title: Two Air Force generals at the Pentagon knew everything

tellings.quote: >> According to Tim, there were two generals at the Pentagon that knew everything.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs are drawn to him, tells on Jesse Michels' podcast what a man named Tim, Timothy Taylor, told him. According to Tim, there were two Air Force generals at the Pentagon, the US military headquarters, who knew everything about the subject. If true, it would mean the full story of UFOs is known at the very top of the military.
